content.text: Lots of kids Milo's age are still co-sleeping, and at 5 he can handle a gradual move. Tonight, try a sleep-over-on-the-floor setup. Do the usual bedtime routine in his own room, then stay on a mattress or chair beside his bed until he's asleep. After a few nights, move your spot a bit farther from him, toward the door. Tell him the plan in the daytime so it isn't a surprise at bedtime.
